paragraphs: The 218d has been part of the 2 Series range since 2014, spanning two generations under one badge. The F22/F23 generation (2014–2021) uses the B47 — a 2.0-litre four-cylinder diesel that replaced the earlier N47. From 2021, the G42 generation continues with the same B47 engine, a well-regarded unit that's significantly more reliable than the N47 it replaced. The 218d is offered in both Coupe (F22/G42) and Convertible (F23) body styles, with the G42 generation currently in production.
about.boldParagraph: The 218d is no longer in production, but we continue to rebuild and replace engines for every one still on the road.
